name: What happens after I select my pre-construction unit?

mainEntity.name: What happens after I select my pre-construction unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: After selecting your unit, you will typically proceed to sign the formal purchase contract with the developer, often following a specified rescission period during which you can review the documents and potentially withdraw your offer without penalty. Deposits will be structured according to a payment schedule as construction progresses. Our role continues in guiding you through each contractual milestone, ensuring you meet deadlines and understand the ongoing communication from the developer.
acceptedAnswer.description: After selection, you sign the purchase contract, adhere to a deposit schedule, and follow the development's contractual milestones.
